outcome: Mode of delivery (Caesarean or vaginal operative delivery)
cohort: 12,396 singleton pregnancies at ≥ 37 weeks gestation with complete fetal biometry within 7 days before delivery
finding: While soHC and soAC were significantly associated with the need for operative delivery and soAC with shoulder dystocia, the overall ability of fetal biometry to predict adverse perinatal outcomes was poor.
